=== items/list-items.yaml
# Imported from OpenAPI: Inventory Service

request:
  name: List items
  method: GET
  url: ${INVENTORY_SERVICE_BASE_URL}/items
  params:
    # limit: "1"
    category: tools
  auth:
    type: bearer
    token: ${INVENTORY_SERVICE_BEARER_AUTH_TOKEN}
  expect:
    status: 200

=== items/create-item.yaml
# Imported from OpenAPI: Inventory Service

request:
  name: Create item
  method: POST
  url: ${INVENTORY_SERVICE_BASE_URL}/items
  headers:
    Content-Type: application/json
  auth:
    type: bearer
    token: ${INVENTORY_SERVICE_BEARER_AUTH_TOKEN}
  body:
    name: Hammer
    quantity: 0
    tags:
      - string
  expect:
    status: 201

=== items/get-item.yaml
# Imported from OpenAPI: Inventory Service

global:
  variables:
    itemId: 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000

request:
  name: Get item
  method: GET
  url: ${INVENTORY_SERVICE_BASE_URL}/items/${itemId}
  auth:
    type: bearer
    token: ${INVENTORY_SERVICE_BEARER_AUTH_TOKEN}
  expect:
    status: 200

=== items/replace-item.yaml
# Imported from OpenAPI: Inventory Service

global:
  variables:
    itemId: 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000

request:
  name: Replace item
  method: PUT
  url: ${INVENTORY_SERVICE_BASE_URL}/items/${itemId}
  headers:
    Content-Type: application/json
  auth:
    type: bearer
    token: ${INVENTORY_SERVICE_BEARER_AUTH_TOKEN}
  body:
    name: Hammer
    quantity: 0
    tags:
      - string
  expect:
    status: 204

=== items/delete-item.yaml
# Imported from OpenAPI: Inventory Service

global:
  variables:
    itemId: 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000

request:
  name: Delete item
  method: DELETE
  url: ${INVENTORY_SERVICE_BASE_URL}/items/${itemId}
  auth:
    type: bearer
    token: ${INVENTORY_SERVICE_BEARER_AUTH_TOKEN}
  expect:
    status: 204

=== items/set-item-tree.yaml
# Imported from OpenAPI: Inventory Service

global:
  variables:
    itemId: string

request:
  name: Set item tree
  method: POST
  url: ${INVENTORY_SERVICE_BASE_URL}/items/${itemId}/tree
  headers:
    Content-Type: application/json
  auth:
    type: bearer
    token: ${INVENTORY_SERVICE_BEARER_AUTH_TOKEN}
  body:
    label: string
    children:
      - {}
  expect:
    status: 200

=== orders/place-order.yaml
# Imported from OpenAPI: Inventory Service

request:
  name: Place order
  method: POST
  url: ${INVENTORY_SERVICE_BASE_URL}/orders
  headers:
    Content-Type: application/json
  auth:
    type: bearer
    token: ${INVENTORY_SERVICE_BEARER_AUTH_TOKEN}
  body:
    itemId: string
    store: string
  expect:
    status: 202

=== orders/get-order.yaml
# Imported from OpenAPI: Inventory Service

global:
  variables:
    orderId: "1"

request:
  name: Get order
  method: GET
  url: ${INVENTORY_SERVICE_BASE_URL}/orders/${orderId}
  auth:
    type: bearer
    token: ${INVENTORY_SERVICE_BEARER_AUTH_TOKEN}
  expect:
    status: 200

=== orders/pay-order.yaml
# Imported from OpenAPI: Inventory Service
# Optional form fields: save_card

global:
  variables:
    orderId: "1"

request:
  name: Pay order
  method: POST
  url: ${INVENTORY_SERVICE_BASE_URL}/orders/${orderId}/pay
  headers:
    Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
  auth:
    type: bearer
    token: ${INVENTORY_SERVICE_BEARER_AUTH_TOKEN}
  body: card_token=string
  expect:
    status: 200

=== shipments/list-shipments.yaml
# Imported from OpenAPI: Inventory Service

request:
  name: List shipments
  method: GET
  url: ${INVENTORY_SERVICE_BASE_URL}/shipments
  headers:
    X-Inventory-Key: ${INVENTORY_SERVICE_KEY_AUTH}
  expect:
    status: 200

=== shipments/create-shipment.yaml
# Imported from OpenAPI: Inventory Service

request:
  name: Create shipment
  method: POST
  url: ${INVENTORY_SERVICE_BASE_URL}/shipments
  headers:
    Content-Type: application/json
  auth:
    type: bearer
    token: ${INVENTORY_SERVICE_BEARER_AUTH_TOKEN}
  body:
    orderId: 1
    note: string
  expect:
    status: 201

=== shipments/update-shipment.yaml
# Imported from OpenAPI: Inventory Service

global:
  variables:
    shipmentId: string

request:
  name: Update shipment
  method: PATCH
  url: ${INVENTORY_SERVICE_BASE_URL}/shipments/${shipmentId}
  headers:
    Content-Type: application/json
  auth:
    type: bearer
    token: ${INVENTORY_SERVICE_BEARER_AUTH_TOKEN}
  body:
    status: packed
  expect:
    status: 200
